title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform
snippet: If one customer reports a problem, you can trace 100% of traffic for their hostname, source IP, or identifying request header while leaving everyone else at 1%. Or during an investigation, you could trace 100% of requests carrying a temporary debug header, while leaving all other traffic at the baseline.

title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone
snippet: Workers: Your Worker can now use 1 second of startup time (up from 400 ms), send and receive 32 MiB WebSocket messages (up from 1 MiB), and make up to 1 millions subrequests per request (up from 1,000). Workers can now be up to 64 MiB uncompressed (previously 10 MB), and we’ve relaxed the concurrent connection limit.
